text:
Reviewed the whole repo. Overall: **5/10**. The structure is clean and the tests pass, but the ingestion pipeline is too trusting for production data and has one correctness bug that can silently corrupt reports across re-ingests.

I would **not approve as-is**. `python -m pytest -q` passes; `compileall` was blocked because `/work` is mounted read-only for `__pycache__` writes.

issues.description: Re-ingest clears metadata tables but leaves old results, so stale rows remain when inputs shrink or disappear.
JSONL parsing assumes each decoded value and metrics field is a dict, so valid JSON arrays/scalars or non-dict metrics crash ingest.
Malformed XML raises ParseError and aborts ingest instead of recording a warning as documented.
XML parsing is not hardened against DTD/entity payloads, which is risky for untrusted input.
Non-finite scores such as NaN pass validation and can crash on insert or poison downstream stats.
Missing run_id/model/task values are accepted; empty run IDs collide under the unique key and overwrite rows.
Harness A header is ignored, so reordered or incorrect CSV columns silently misparse or skip rows.
report() creates and initializes a new empty database when the requested DB path does not exist, hiding configuration mistakes.
Fixture generation recursively deletes any existing target directory without a safety check or confirmation.
Idempotence coverage re-ingests identical fixtures only, missing the stale-results bug when inputs change.
